title: Para Bellum content: division templates
description:
One row per division template: what a division raised from it costs to train, how long it takes, how fast it moves, and what it draws from the stockpile. File: Content/<namespace>/template.json, in any namespace: a formation's identity is a content id, so a mod adds a division the way it adds a model, and a player's own live in the save under player:. A requirement names a CLASS, and it is filled by designs of that class newest-first (along supersedes, then by year), models and variants alike. The contract is docs/design/CONTENT_MODEL.md section 4 in the game repository.

Recorded limitation: a requirement cannot ask for one specific model (for example, a light tank for reconnaissance).

id.description: This template's identity, which a formation and a save refer to. The folder's namespace, and unique among templates.

name.description: What the player reads. Optional for a mod, required of shipped content (C802); a missing or blank name displays the id.

symbol.description: Which counter symbol the map draws for a division of this template, listed in Content/vocabulary.json counter_symbols. The drawing is the game's code; which one a template uses is data.

cost.description: What training one division costs, keyed by pool. Any engine pool may appear; an omitted pool costs none.

training_days.description: How long training one division takes, in whole days.

speed_km_per_day.description: How far a division of this type moves per day. This is the one source of unit speed.

class.description: The class required, by id. At least one design must belong to it.

count.description: How many units of that class the division draws.
